description: This file is a Markdown document containing a tutorial for implementing SQL database interactions using FastAPI and SQLModel in Python. It includes explanations, code snippets, and instructions for setting up models, database engine, CRUD operations, and server execution.

classes.name: HeroBase
classes.description: A base Pydantic model defining common hero attributes, used for multiple models.

classes.name: Hero
classes.description: A SQLModel model representing the hero table, including all fields and primary key.

classes.name: HeroPublic
classes.description: A public-facing data model for hero, exposing only safe fields for API responses.

classes.name: HeroCreate
classes.description: A data model for creating new heroes, excluding auto-generated or sensitive fields.

classes.name: HeroUpdate
classes.description: A data model for updating heroes, with all fields optional for partial updates.

methods.name: create_engine
methods.description: Creates a SQLAlchemy engine for database connection.

methods.name: create_all
methods.description: Creates database tables based on SQLModel models.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Dependency function that yields a SQLModel session per request.

methods.name: startup_event
methods.description: Event handler to initialize database tables on app startup.

methods.name: create_hero
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new hero, receives HeroCreate, returns HeroPublic.

methods.name: read_heroes
methods.description: Endpoint to list heroes, returns a list of HeroPublic.

methods.name: read_hero
methods.description: Endpoint to get a hero by ID, returns HeroPublic.

methods.name: delete_hero
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a hero by ID.
